240-5470-7060-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
240-5470-7060-7272.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

553-7910.description:
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Bilbo's Gambit by paying its mana cost, returning Approach of the Second Sun to your hand.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying its mana cost, causing you to win the game.

206-5078-6766-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3899-5972-5973.easyPrerequisites:
Griffin Guide attached to another creature you control.
You control an additional creature beyond those included above and the one that has Griffin Guide attached.
3899-5972-5973.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature with Griffin Guide attached.
When the creature dies, Cass and Griffin Guide trigger.
Resolve the Griffin Guide trigger, creating a 2/2 Griffin creature token.
Resolve the Cass trigger, returning Griffin Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

618-3305-6798.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Body Launderer with haste.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki.
When Kiki-Jiki dies, each Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing them to each connive.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the token Body Launderer.
When the Body Launderer token dies, its second ability triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1603-1619-3680.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1603-1619-3680.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Stunt Double and Evil Twin each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Stunt Double trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Evil Twin trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1603-1619-3680.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2685-3263-4186-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2685-3263-4186-7743.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1580-4871-6112-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2438-2946-4871-7316.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2438-2946-4871-7316.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rat King trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2724-3194-7715.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using The Mighty Thor. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

7009-7638-7704.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
7009-7638-7704.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mind Stone triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Doc Samson.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

372-2187-7431.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Daydream exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-2187-7431.description:
Cast Daydream by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Possessed Skaab and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Possessed Skaab trigger.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Daydream from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Daydream.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Possessed Skaab and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1988-3490-4779-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
1988-3490-4779-7426.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Blade of the Bloodchief triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat

628-4050-7216.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Moonlit Lamenter.
When Moonlit Lamenter dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

465-997-4605-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Wormfang Drake and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Wormfang Drake.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
465-997-4605-7260.notes: You can either cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand or for the harmonize cost, adjusting mana requirements accordingly.

1409-2307-4365.description:
Activate Corsair Captain by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Corsair Captain enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Corsair Captain.
Resolve the Corsair Captain trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2034-2048-2350-4871-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Stone Calendar.
Repeat.

104-1086-3490-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-1086-3490-4050.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-1939-3490-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-1939-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Regardless, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}
When the Servo dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve either the Lunarch Veteran or Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain life
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

5412-5531-6621-6664.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
5412-5531-6621-6664.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2060-2438-3693-5544-6431.manaNeeded: {B} if Crystalline Crawler does not have a +1/+1 counter on it
2060-2438-3693-5544-6431.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
If able, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Forsaken Miner enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Walking Ballista ability from step 3.
Repeat.

222-527-1251-4050.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee, adding two mana of any color
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2092-4131-4324.notablePrerequisites:
Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 1 or greater.
2092-4131-4324.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Workshop Elders triggers, causing Basalt Monolith to become a 0/0 artifact creature, then putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying at most {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

1137-2136-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Orthion.
1137-2136-2178.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Rith's Attendant with haste.
Activate a Rith's Attendant token by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {R}{G}{W}.
When the Rith's Attendant token dies, Orthion triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2 for each remaining Rith's Attendant token.
Repeat from step 1.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Rith's Attendant tokens and/or target any other creature.

678-1402-3499.description:
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
Diamond Lion dies, triggering Enduring Renewal, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
Repeat.

618-1309-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets with haste.
The token copy of Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
